questions.1: Is the intended outcome, accountable authority, scope and material context explicit?
questions.2: Do all parties mean the same thing and is uncertainty represented?
questions.3: Are decisions, policy constraints, evidence obligations, trade-offs and escalation rules justified?
questions.4: Does the design satisfy the accepted semantics and controls without inventing new facts?
questions.5: Is the design implemented through permitted tools and bounded execution mechanisms?
questions.6: Is the observable result evidenced, attributable, reproducible and suitable for authority review?
